This paper presents the proposed sensor and vision based agricultural robot for sowing seeds. This prototype can navigate it on any agricultural land and perform seed sowing operation simultaneously. The on- board sensors along with visi on system and vision based approaches achieves the navigation and localization tasks. Self- awareness of the robot’s position is determined by the global and local maps generated from Global Positioning System (GPS) and on-board vision system paired with a personal computer. A suspension system has been used to maintain the stability of the vehicle and prevent it from toppling in motion.
